entities.name: Leonard Hawkes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leonard Hawkes FRS was a British geologist. Awarded the Murchison Medal in 1946 and the Wollaston Medal in 1962. He was head of the geology department at Bedford College, London between 1921 and 1956.
